# The Dyrt

> The Dyrt is a comprehensive camping platform connecting campers with thousands of US campgrounds including tent sites, RV parks, glamping, and cabins with verified reviews and real-time availability alerts.

The Dyrt serves as a centralized marketplace for discovering and booking diverse camping accommodations across the United States. The platform empowers both campers searching for their next adventure and landowners looking to monetize their properties through commission-free hosting.

## Key Topics

- Tent Camping
- RV Parks
- Glamping
- Campground Reviews
- Camping Reservations

## Core Camping Discovery

- [The Dyrt Homepage](https://thedyrt.com): Comprehensive camping app for discovering all US campgrounds with filtering and booking
- [Tent Camping Near Me](https://thedyrt.com/tent-camping-near-me): Find and compare tent campgrounds with reviews near your location
- [RV Camping Near Me](https://thedyrt.com/rv-camping-near-me): Discover RV parks and resorts with full-hookup sites and verified reviews

## Availability & Reservations

- [Dyrt Alerts](https://thedyrt.com/alerts): Automated campground availability scanner with text notifications for sold-out sites

## Hosting & Monetization

- [Host Camping on My Land](https://thedyrt.com/claim): List and host properties on The Dyrt with commission-free bookings and earn money

## Bay Area Campgrounds

- [Top Campgrounds Near San Francisco](https://thedyrt.com/camping/california/near/san-francisco): 137 campgrounds near San Francisco with coastal and forest options
- [Kirby Cove Campground](https://thedyrt.com/camping/california/kirby-cove-campground): Walk-in campground with Golden Gate Bridge views in Golden Gate National Recreation Area
- [Angel Island State Park - Sunrise Campground](https://thedyrt.com/camping/california/angel-island-state-park): Island camping with ferry access and San Francisco Bay views
- [San Francisco RV Resort](https://thedyrt.com/camping/california/san-francisco-rv-resort): Oceanfront RV resort in Pacifica with Pacific Ocean and island views
- [H. Dana Bower Rest Area Northbound](https://thedyrt.com/camping/california/h-dana-bower-rest-area-northbound): Free rest area camping in Bay Area with RV sites and dog-friendly access

## Community & Engagement

- [Review Campgrounds & Win](https://thedyrt.com/contests): Win outdoor gear and discounts by reviewing campgrounds on The Dyrt

## Membership & Gifts

- [Dyrt Camping Gift Card](https://thedyrt.com/pro/gift): Gift PRO membership annual subscriptions for camping enthusiasts
